_readme: QUEENSTOWN PARTS PRICE LIST (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-20). Researched NZ shelf prices, not placeholders, but CHECK WITH THE FIRST TRADIES.
Each price is what the owner pays for one, including GST. The tradie gets it less 3%; HostFix keeps 3%, which covers the card fee.

Where they came from: the retailer's own product or category page, 19 November 2026. Both retailers refused automated visits (HTTP 403), so each price was read from the web search engine's copy of that page, not from the page itself.
This file only fills an EMPTY list, once. After that, change prices on the admin screen: More > Markets, prices and the menu.
